entities.summary: Basil Harry Losten was a bishop of the Ukrainian Greek Catholic Church. He was until his death Bishop Emeritus of the Ukrainian Catholic Diocese of Stamford, Connecticut. He was succeeded by Bishop Paul Patrick Chomnycky.
